scripts.codegen: npm run codegen:ts && npm run codegen:py
scripts.codegen:ts: json2ts -i apps/schema/constraint.schema.json -o apps/frontend/src/generated/constraint.ts --cwd apps/schema && json2ts -i apps/schema/constraint.schema.json -o apps/backend/src/generated/constraint.ts --cwd apps/schema
scripts.dev: npm run cf:typegen && npm run build --workspace=@jphack-2026/frontend && concurrently --kill-others --names frontend,backend "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run cf:typegen && npm run build --workspace=@jphack-2026/frontend && npm run build:workers
scripts.build:workers: npm run build:workers:develop && npm run build:workers:main
scripts.typecheck: npm run cf:typegen && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run codegen:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:develop: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env develop --secrets-file .env.develop
scripts.deploy:main: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env main --secrets-file .env.main
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env develop --local
scripts.db:migrate:develop: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env develop --remote
scripts.db:migrate:main: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env main --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --env develop --local --file apps/backend/db/seed.sql
